# Women in Logic Online

Women in Logic Online is the seminar series of the Women in Logic collective: online talks by women working in logic, open to everyone. Talks are planned about every two months.

Agata Ciabattoni and Josephine Dik started the series in March 2024, with help from Andrea Hackl and the [Vienna Center for Logic and Algorithms (VCLA)](https://www.vcla.at/). In March 2026, the organization moved to University College London, where Elaine Pimentel, Maria Osório Costa, and Ekaterina Piotrovskaya now run it, supported by UCL's Programming Principles, Logic, and Verification group.

## Recordings

All the recordings are collected on our YouTube channel, [WiL Online](https://www.youtube.com/@WiLONLINE-y10), in two playlists:

- [WiL Online at VCLA (2024–2026)](https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLM8bSDg4Aq1w): the first seven talks, organized in Vienna.
- [WiL Online at UCL (2026–)](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qBAOWL5IE34&list=PLLpqwHIn4Wx4): the talks organized at UCL.

The VCLA talks also remain on the [VCLA channel](https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLdqgJshpd1aWOGdqfrloD69Ev1MSPd0Wg), and all recordings are listed in [Recorded Talks](https://womeninlogic.org/RecordedTalks/).
